Title: Dependency audit is non-blocking in CI
Description: pnpm audit --audit-level=high ran with continue-on-error: true because there was no real dependency tree yet to triage. Resolved in MVP-002: real findings appeared (see TD-002), were fixed, and the step was made blocking.

Title: Vulnerable transitive deps of the prisma CLI pinned via pnpm override
Description: pnpm audit found HIGH-severity deepmerge-ts and mysql2 advisories, both transitive build-time-only deps of prisma@7.10.0 (latest stable 7.x). Pinned patched versions via pnpm-workspace.yaml overrides; verified prisma generate/migrate diff still work.

Title: Row Level Security disabled on ppuniverse-dev Supabase tables
Description: Supabase security advisor flagged RLS disabled on users/accounts/sessions/verification_tokens/file_scans. Resolved per docs/final-decisions.md: RLS approved and required, implemented as enabled-with-zero-policies (portable standard SQL, app's own table-owner connection unaffected). Verified against ppuniverse-dev: advisor ERROR cleared to an expected INFO note; owner-role queries still work.

Title: File scan pipeline runs synchronously in the request not via job queue
Description: completeFileUpload() runs the full scan pipeline (policy re-check, magic bytes, malware scan, zone move) inline in the POST /api/files/uploads/complete request instead of a durable queue (TRD's architecture default). No story yet owns job-queue infrastructure. Risk: large-file scans block the request and a mid-scan crash leaves a FileScan row stuck in SCANNING with no retry.

Title: FR-002 filter axes deferred pending fields owned by later stories
Description: MVP-004 delivered keyword search/category filter/sort/pagination. FR-002's license, compatibility, free/paid, accessibility-status and update-recency filters (and 'AI') were not built because their fields did not exist or have no owning story; FR-002 traceability was overstated as Implemented and is corrected to Partially Implemented. Needs a product-owner backlog decision for the follow-up.

Title: Compatibility evidence write-time rules exist but no write path enforces them yet
Description: validateCompatibilityEntry (Tested requires evidence summary + verified date, wave needs area, year/wave/length rules) and DB CHECK constraints exist, but MVP-005 has no creator/moderator write surface so nothing calls the validator yet. No automated screening of notes/summaries for private data (tenant IDs, credentials, test-environment details) exists; who may assign statuses was decided 2026-09-21 (creators Creator Declared, moderators Marketplace Reviewed, Tested reserved) but the role rules are not enforced anywhere yet and the built vocabulary predates the decision (TD-008). Must be enforced by MVP-012/013 before any evidence can be written through the product.

Title: FR-003 product-page items beyond license/version/support/compatibility have no delivering story
Description: FR-003 also lists creator, screenshots, demo, price, prerequisites, setup, accessibility statement, changelog, version history and related assets; MVP-005's acceptance criteria cover only license/version/support/compatibility so FR-003 is recorded Partially Implemented. Also: no Playwright E2E journey for the product detail page (E2E tooling is not configured repo-wide); coverage is unit + DB-gated integration + manual browser and axe-core verification. Dispositions recorded 2026-09-21: creator to MVP-011, price to MVP-007, the rest proposed as PROP-001 to PROP-005 in planning/proposed-stories.md (not approved). Stays Open until those are approved and scheduled.

Title: MVP-005 evidence vocabulary predates the 2026-09-21 Tested / Marketplace Reviewed decision
Description: The product owner decided creators assign Creator Declared, moderators assign Marketplace Reviewed, and Tested is reserved. Resolved 2026-09-24: MARKETPLACE_REVIEWED enum value and nullable reviewedAt column added (two migrations, CHECK constraint keeps them in lockstep, verified against a real database both directions); validateCompatibilityEntry now rejects TESTED/NOT_VERIFIED as reserved/legacy; the public legend and compatibility matrix show only the two assignable statuses (fail closed for any legacy row). Still open, deliberately: the write path itself, moderation workflow, ModerationReview/AuditEvent entities and role enforcement remain MVP-012/013's scope, not built here. See planning/tech-debt/TD-008.md.

Title: No environment-level noindex switch for staging and preview deployments
Description: Indexable pages emit index/follow, a canonical and a sitemap whenever NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL is valid, with nothing distinguishing production from a public staging or preview deployment. Deferred because the hosting model is undecided (open question 5). Needs an explicit environment setting that forces noindex, an empty sitemap and Disallow: / for non-production.

Title: Sitemap is a single file capped at 50000 URLs (no sitemap index)
Description: sitemap.xml is one file bounded at the sitemaps.org limit; beyond it the tail is dropped and seo.sitemap_truncated is logged. A sitemap index (generateSitemaps) and an accurate lastmod were not built because the catalog has no inventory. No risk at MVP scale.

Title: main is unprotected and no reviewer or approval rules exist
Description: The 2026-09-21 MVP-023 decision protects develop only (pull request required, 0 approvals, two required checks, force-push and deletion blocked, administrators not enforced). main stays unprotected and no reviewer or approval rules exist; both remain part of open question 17. Delivery discipline is procedural, not enforced by GitHub, for main and for review. Resolve when the product owner decides the rest of open question 17.

Title: A pnpm hook removes Next.js's optional @playwright/test peer declaration
Description: Without the root .pnpmfile.cjs, pnpm resolves Next.js's optional @playwright/test peer from the workspace and links Playwright into the web app's production dependency tree (Q41: dev-only, not shipped). An overrides entry with - did not remove a peer link. Revisit on each Next.js upgrade.

Title: router.refresh() can leave document metadata (<title>) briefly absent; only /account/sessions has a mitigation
Description: BUG-013's fix mitigates this on /account/sessions only. The underlying gap between router.refresh() and the framework re-applying document metadata is not understood or fixed; SessionRevokeButton is the only current router.refresh() call site, but a future one is not covered. See planning/tech-debt/TD-013.md.

Title: Admin deletion-request queue has no pagination, filtering or sorting
Description: listActiveDeletionRequests() and the /admin/deletion-requests page return every active request in one unbounded query, oldest first, with no page size limit, filter or alternate sort. Deliberate scope narrowing (admin tooling was not part of this story's authorized scope); not a defect at current/near-term scale (no production inventory yet). See planning/tech-debt/TD-014.md.

Title: Transactional email is sent synchronously in the request path, with no retry
Description: sendTransactional/sendOptional call the EmailAdapter directly inside the triggering HTTP request (sign-in link, deletion-request acknowledgement); same class of gap as TD-004 (no job-queue infrastructure exists). No retry: a failed send is recorded and surfaced via telemetry but never attempted again. Building a queue was explicitly out of this story's scope. See planning/tech-debt/TD-015.md.

Title: Article publishing has no content versioning, only a bare publish-event log
Description: ArticlePublishEvent records that a publish happened (who/what/when) but never snapshots the document content itself. No correction/republish path exists yet for Article, so there is nothing for a version history to distinguish between today; will matter once one is added. See planning/tech-debt/TD-016.md.

Title: Article body is stored as Markdown but rendered as plain, preformatted text, not converted to HTML
Description: Deliberate security-first choice: no Markdown-to-HTML renderer or sanitizer dependency was added in this pass, so published content is functionally readable but shows literal Markdown syntax instead of rendered formatting. See planning/tech-debt/TD-017.md.

Title: Compatibility-evidence display labels still say 'Creator' after the first-party-only decision
Description: CREATOR_DECLARED and CREATOR_SUPPORTED enum values display as "Creator Declared"/"Creator-supported" on live product pages; the first-party-only decision (docs/final-decisions.md) records CREATOR_DECLARED should display as "Publisher declared", with CREATOR_SUPPORTED's wording needing a separate review. No enum, validator, production code, snapshot or test changed. See planning/tech-debt/TD-018.md.

Title: Admin product/release editor pages registered in the a11y route-coverage gate but not yet exercised by the Playwright a11y suite
Description: GATED_ROUTES lists /admin/products, /admin/products/new and /admin/products/[id]/edit (pnpm test passes), but no matching Playwright a11y states exist yet in packages/e2e/src/pages.ts, so pnpm test:a11y does not currently exercise these pages. Deferred: the a11y suite needs a production build, a browser install and a local/CI Postgres with E2E_ALLOW_DATABASE_WRITES=1, not reliably provisionable in this pass. See planning/tech-debt/TD-019.md.
